description: Labelled cases for the deterministic platform router. Expected values are the routing outcome, not the LLM narrative, because route_platform() decides the verdict and the model only explains it.

cases.problem: Calculate the ground state energy of the FeMoco nitrogenase cofactor to chemical accuracy
cases.why: Multi-reference iron-sulfur cluster, the canonical class-2 case in arXiv:2409.08910

cases.problem: Simulate the ground state energy of a 50-atom transition metal catalyst active site
cases.why: Transition metal cluster and active site are both class-2 markers

cases.problem: Compute the energy of a closed-shell organic molecule at equilibrium geometry where Hartree-Fock is sufficient
cases.why: F6 must reject this: coupled cluster already resolves single-reference systems

cases.problem: Factor a 2048-bit RSA integer to test post-quantum readiness
cases.why: Shor has a structural superpolynomial speedup

cases.problem: Factor a 2048-bit RSA key to assess post-quantum migration urgency
cases.why: Same problem as crypto-rsa-integer. Different wording must not change the platform.

cases.problem: Break RSA encryption by finding the prime factors of a large semiprime
cases.why: Third phrasing of the same underlying problem

cases.problem: Optimize a portfolio of 500 assets to maximize risk-adjusted return
cases.why: Classical optimisation, no proven quantum advantage

cases.problem: Find the best allocation across 500 equities to maximise Sharpe ratio subject to risk limits
Train an image classifier to detect manufacturing defects from photographs
cases.why: Pattern recognition, squarely an AI/ML workload

cases.problem: Build a model that summarises customer support transcripts and extracts sentiment
cases.why: NLP, no quantum or HPC case

cases.problem: Run computational fluid dynamics simulation over an aircraft wing mesh
Run a finite element analysis of structural stress across a bridge design
cases.why: Finite element analysis is a classic HPC workload

cases.problem: Find the ground state phase diagram of the two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model
Simulate real-time dynamics of a lattice gauge theory with a fermion sign problem
cases.why: Sign problem makes this genuinely hard classically

cases.problem: Search an unstructured database of 10 million records for a matching entry
cases.why: Grover is quadratic and the QRAM loading cost erases it
